content: Jesus Irae Haximarenenai Kakoa
Hatyo najikinita Jesus xane Galiléia koa tonakonisahitene. Maisa Judéia koa xane aokowihitita, naliyerenai judeunai nityohalitiranai aisene aokowiyahitaha hoka.
Exowaka okoi judeunai hisehare aose xane hikoahena. Hatyo hisehaliti xowakehena hoka judeunai hatirisako tyaonahitaha hoka “Hatirisako tyaoniterenai hisehare”, nexaha exaokaka.
Hatyaoseta Jesus ximarenenai nehenaha ihiye: — Hiyanehena Judéia koa maniya hoka hisomitereharenai hisomehena, hiyema tyaoniterenai hománe waiyaha maheta.
Hiyaiya, hatya haliti tahi waiyekehalaka kasemaka aohena hoka maisa hameteneta tyomare. Aliterexe atyo hisomita hoka hiyane ehaotiha hisomehena hoka tyotyaha waiyaha — nexaha ihiye.
Iximarenenai kakoita matyakekotitene hoka nikare iraeta.
Hoka Jesus nexa ihiyeha: — Maisa atyo xane hikoahenere noxanini aose. Hoka xiso xomana atyo haxowaketere.
Maisaiya atyo matyakekoneharenai ehareta xihiye. Hoka nohiye atyo eharahitaha niraini xemere. “Xoana hoka iniyalahare xisomita?” nomihena ihiyeha hoka.
— Xiyane atyo xiyaiye hena hisehaliti. Hoka maisaiya atyo kalikini natyo noxanita, maisa terota atyo xane hikoahenere noxanini aose — nexa Jesus haximarenenai hiye.
Nexa ihiyeha hoka hekota Jesus Galiléia koa nali.
Jesus Xane Hatirisakorenai Hisehare Ana
Hatyaoseta iximarenenai xaneha waiyaha maheta hisehaliti. Xaneha hoka hatyo najikinita Jesus tehitiya xane. Xane xakore atyo hoka hameteneta atyo xane, maisa atyo halitinai semahitaha exánene.
Hatyaoseta judeunai nityohalitiranai tawehenene hatyo hisehaliti koa nali. — Xoana koxaka kaoka ali? nexa axaha hatyo nali tyaoniterenai.
Hisehaliti koa nali tyaoniterenai kahare iraehenaha etahi akiti. Haiyanai atyo nexa exaokaka: — Hatyo atyo waiye — nexahitaha. Hoka haiyanai atyo nexa: — Hatyo atyo maoseratita wiso — nexahitaha.
Kahare iraeha etahi akiti hoka maisa atyo tyotya haliti haoti xini, mairahitaha judeunai nityohalitiranai hoka.
Hatyaoseta koxaka 4-ki ferakenehena ihisehareha tyaonita hoka Jesus xane isoa Iraexatyakalati Hanako hoka aotyakihenahene.
Aotyakisahitene hoka judeunai semahitaha exaotyakira hoka nexahitaha: — Aliyakerala hoka waiyore iraeta, maisa xakore waha kaxaotyakisakita hoka? nexa hakaharetyoaha.
Hoka Jesus nehena ihiyeha: — Maisa atyo noxaotyakiri xini, noxaxikatyasehare Enore xaotyakira atyo hoka nikareta naotyakijita.

Xala xamani atyo Enore aokitere akereta tyoma aokowita hoka ekakoita ite waiyore noxaotyakiri kakoa hoka nehenaite: “Hatyo exaotyakira atyo Enore xaotyakira terota, maisa haxaotyakira kakoa xini aotyakijita wiso”.
Hatya halitiya atyo iraeta hatahita hoka hatyota atyo haxaexakerityaka aokita. Hoka haxaxikatyasehare xaexakerityakaiya aokita hoka hatyoiya atyo tota maniya tyaonita, maisaiya atyo maoseraita xini.

— Moisés halakisa haxaotyakira xomana xisaona maheta exema maniya xakore hoka maisa atyo xisaonare exema. Xisaonitaiya exema maniya hoka maisaiya xaisa xaokowiye natyo. Xoana hoka nikareta xiso? nexa Jesus.
— Xala aisa aokowita hiso? Kala tihanare tyaonita hikakoa hoka nikare hiraeta — nexa halitinai iniraene nahalakoa.
Hatyaoseta Jesus nehena: — Kafaka hatya haliti hokakita hoka naiyatelikihetene hoka xityotya xahakaharetyoa.

— Xiso atyo enamokose tyaohena hoka enomanere milihe xaikotita Moisés xaotyakira akereta, sábado ferakenehena hoka. Maisa hatyo akiti Moisés xowaka rotita xini nikare kaomaka. Enahetakomaniyerenai hotohare nikare tyaonita hoka Moisés xairahetene babera koa.

Mahateniti ferakene xakore atyo hoka Moisés niraene xema sábado ferakenehena hoka enamokose nomanere milihe xaikotita hoka waiyeta xihiye. Hoka xoanere hoka xehareta nohiye sábado xowaka naiyatelikihetehena haliti hoka?
Waiyehena nikare xahekotya. Waiye maniya xamohena xiyahekola — nexa Jesus ihiyeha.
Jesus Ála Enore Kalorexe Aohenere?
Hatyaoseta haiyanai Jerusalém yerenai nehena: — Xoana aliterexe exe haliti aisaha aokowiyahitaha?
Hiyaiya, wityotya wihaoti iraeta hoka maisa winityohalitiranai xoare nexareha ihiye, maisa mahokoanityareha iniraine. Xoana Enore Kalorexe Aohenere tehitiyala aokahitene? nexahitaha.
— Enore Kalorexe Aohenere ite tyohena hoka maisaite waiyekehalakita womana hetati kaotyakehenere aose kakoa. Xakore hoka exe haliti nawenane aose atyo waiyekehalakita womana — nexa iraekakoahitaha.

Hatyaoseta Jesus aotyakijita Iraexatyakalati Hanako hoka nexa: — Xoana aliterexe xiyaiyanehare natyo, exahe nawenani aose hoka waiyekehalakita xomana? Hatya axikatya natyo haliti koni, maisa noxaokalita xini nokaotyaki haliti koni. Noxaxikatyasehare atyo maisa maoseratyaliye, xakore hoka maisa atyo xiyaiyanehare xini.
Hoka natyo atyo nowaiyitene, ehaliyata atyo notyoa, exaxikalahare atyo natyo hoka — nexa Jesus kinatyaxa iraeta.
Hatyaoseta otokaha xakore Jesus aokowiha hoka maisa xala harenai otokarene, maisa exotokakaose xane hikoahenere hoka maisa otokahitene.

Kahare haiyaharenai nali tyaoniterenai tyakekoha Jesus hoka nexaha: — Exe haliti kahare tyomita maomakahare wityakekone maheta. Xoana Enore Kalorexe Aohenere kaite tyohena hoka exe xahehare kaite tyomehena maomakahare? nexa axakakoahitaha.
Axikatyaha Sorarenai Otokaha Maheta Jesus
Fariseunai sema halitinai niraene Jesus tahi akiti hoka hatyo hiyeta axikatyaha sorarenai otokahene maheta. Sacerdotenai xekohasenai tehitiya kahinaetyahene hoka sorarenai axikatyaha.
Hoka Jesus nehena: — Iniraite notyaohitiya xikakoa hoka hatyohekotaite noxaniheta noxaxikatyasehare nali.
Noxanihetaite hoka xatawaite natyo hoka maisaiya xikaokehitita natyo. Hoka xisoiya atyo maisa aliyakere xiyaneta noxanihenere nali — nexa.

Hatyaoseta judeunai nexa iraekakoahenaha: — Aliyakoiyala xane hoka maisa wikaokehititene? Xoana sekoala xanehena Grécia koa nali hoka judeunai tyaonahitere nali ala tyaohena? Xoana Grécia yerenai tehitiyalaite aotyakihena?
Xoana ala hoka nikare iraeta: “Noxanihetaite hoka xatawaite natyo hoka maisaiya xikaokehitita natyo. Hoka xisoiya atyo maisa aliyakere xiyaneta noxanihenere nali”, nita? nexaha.
Hatya Oneseta Wenati Waiyexe Kaotyakehena

Miyanitiye hisehaliti ferakene xowakehena kahare haliti hohisakoita hoka Jesus tityoa enekonyaha hoka kinatyaxa iraihena: — Xala xamani oinita hoka tyoa nomani hoka nisa enomana one hoka tera — nexa. “One”, nitere atyo Isekohaliti Waiyexe xaokaka nikare iraeta.
— Xala xamani tyakeko natyo hoka one ite kahare hikoa ihiyeta hoka tyaona mene matyotenehare Iraiti Waiyexe nanekoa iraetere akereta — nexa Jesus.

Jesus atyo Isekohaliti Waiyexe xaokaka iraeta. Exowakita maisa Isekohaliti Waiyexe kaokare tyakekohenerenai ana. Hoka Jesus waini hoka kaseheta hoka kalorexe tyaona hotohare hoka hatyaosetaiya Isekohaliti Waiyexe kaoka enomanaha.
Halitinai Exaoretyakakoa
Nexa hoka kahare naliyerenai semaha iniraine hoka nehenaha: — Aliterexe exe haliti atyo iraiti xakaisasehare Moisés aokitere — nexaha.
Haiyanai atyo nexaha: — Exe atyo Enore Kalorexe Aohenere. Hoka haiyanai atyo nexaha: — Xoana Enore Kalorexe Aohenere alaite Galiléia koata tyoa?
Exakere Iraiti Waiyexe nanekoa xairatyoare tyaonita: Enore Kalorexe Aohenere atyoite Davi jikolahare. Belém nali atyoite tyaona Davi tyaonitere nali — nexaha hahinaeharenai niraene nahalakoa.
Hatyaoseta hahekore xakini ahekotya Jesus tahi.
Haiyanai atyo otokaha Jesus aokowiha xakore hoka maisa otokahitene.
Judeunai Nityohalitiranai Maisa Tyakekoahitaha
Hatyaoseta sorarenai haikoaheta fariseunai, sacerdote xekohasenai tyaonahitere nali. Haikoaheta hoka exekohasenai axahene: — Xoana hoka maisa xotokitene hoka ali xanolokitene? nexaha.
Hoka sorarenai nexaha haxekohaseha hiye: — Maisa xala harenai hatyo haliti iraehenere akere iraexe — nexaha.
— Xoana xiso tehitiya emaoserala xema xisaona? nexaha.
— Xoana haiyaharenai kalorexenai, fariseunai xoaha tyakeko iniraine? Xiyaiya, maisa hatya hekoti tyakekore.
Alitere exe haliti hisoakere tyakekotene. Xakore atyo hoka exe halitinai maisa waiyorexeha wiyaotyakisakaho kakoa hoka maisa waiyexeha Enore ana — nexaha sorarenai hiye.
Hatyaoseta Nicodemos nexarexe, makiya xane iraehenere Jesus kakoa, nehena ihiyeha:
— Wiyaotyakisakaho hiyeta atyo maisa haliti waberexotyare rota. Wasema hotohare atyo iniraene, exahe etahi akiti hoka waberexowita — nexa.
— Xoana hiso tehitiya Galiléia koatare? Hiyane hiyaiya babera iraiti xakaisaseharenai niraine kakoare. Maisa iraiti xakaisasehare kaotyakita Galiléia koata — nexaha ihiye.
Nexa hoka hatyaoseta iniraikakoaneha tyotya hoka xanehenahitaha hahanaha nihatyaka.
